description: Kinkerstraat 1888-1897 shop rows (18-4, 186-202, 206-210, 296-300, 338-340): red-brown brick, 2 axes per ~4 m module, segmental-arched sash windows with white blocked arch rings (springer blocks, two voussoirs, keystone), a white sill course and a white impost-block course on every upper storey, heavy cream stucco cornice with consoles; crowns: one pediment dormer with scrolled sides per module, none, a stepped corner gable, a flat-topped tower-dormer; every ground floor its own shop

pediment-dormer.note: one pedimented dormer with scrolled cheeks per module, centred, standing behind the cornice (2-30 pands 6-14; 206-242 pands 14-15)

step-gable.note: Kinkerstraat 2 (163325): a dark brick stepped gable over the whole front, 2 steps a side, one attic window; top ~2.6 m over the cornice line on the strip

tower.note: 186-202 (157310, 161134): a brick dormer-tower with an arched light over both axes

rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: 2 equal axes, no balconies
rhythm.symmetry: symmetric about the module centre above the shop
rhythm.roofline: heavy cream stucco cornice with consoles and a frieze; one pediment dormer per module
schemaLimits: the dark rubbed-brick ring under the white blocks is not drawn (no band brick measured)
the impost course on the photo is a dotted line of white blocks at the springing line; the kit's painted head band is continuous (bands: painted)
pediment dormer cheeks are plain (no scrolls); the frieze consoles and panels are a plain frieze
iron wall anchors between the windows are not drawn
